controls.title: S3 Bucket Server-Side Encryption
controls.risk: Without encryption at rest, anyone who gains unauthorized access to the underlying storage can read the raw data directly.
controls.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration resource for this bucket with sse_algorithm = "AES256".

controls.title: S3 Bucket Versioning
controls.risk: Without versioning, an accidental or malicious overwrite/delete permanently destroys the data — there is no way to recover a prior version.
controls.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_versioning resource for this bucket with status = "Enabled".

controls.title: S3 Block Public Access
controls.risk: Disabling this safeguard means the bucket could be made publicly accessible, intentionally or by mistake, exposing its contents to the entire internet.
controls.remediation: Set block_public_acls, block_public_policy, ignore_public_acls, and restrict_public_buckets to true.

controls.title: RDS Publicly Accessible
controls.risk: A database reachable directly from the internet is one of the most common real-world breach vectors — attackers actively scan for exposed databases.
controls.remediation: Set publicly_accessible = false on the RDS instance, and access it via a bastion host or VPN instead.

controls.title: RDS Storage Encryption
controls.risk: Unencrypted database storage means raw data is readable if the underlying disk is ever accessed without authorization.
controls.remediation: Set storage_encrypted = true on the RDS instance.

controls.title: SSH Open to the Internet
controls.risk: Port 22 open to 0.0.0.0/0 means anyone on the internet can attempt to log into the server — a constant, automated attack target.
controls.remediation: Restrict the security group's ingress CIDR block for port 22 to a specific internal range, not 0.0.0.0/0.

controls.title: RDP Open to the Internet
controls.risk: Same risk as SSH exposure, but for Windows remote desktop access — a very common ransomware entry point in real-world breaches.
controls.remediation: Restrict the security group's ingress CIDR block for port 3389 to a specific internal range, not 0.0.0.0/0.

controls.title: EBS Volume Encryption
controls.risk: An unencrypted disk volume exposes raw data if the volume is ever improperly detached, snapshotted, or accessed outside its intended instance.
controls.remediation: Set encrypted = true on the EBS volume.

controls.title: IAM Wildcard Policy
controls.risk: A policy granting Action="*" and Resource="*" gives full administrative control over the entire AWS account to anything using it — a single compromised credential means total account takeover.
controls.remediation: Scope the policy's Action and Resource fields to only the specific permissions needed, instead of "*".

controls.title: Hardcoded Credentials
controls.risk: A password committed directly in source code is visible to anyone with repo access, remains in Git history forever even if later removed, and is a leading cause of real-world credential leaks.
controls.remediation: Move the password into a Terraform variable marked sensitive = true, supplied via .tfvars (gitignored) or a secrets manager.
